summary: This clinical trial studies how a drug called Empagliflozin affects ketone body production in people with Type 2 Diabetes. The study plans to enroll 29 participants who are between 30 and 75 years old. Researchers want to learn more about how the body handles fat breakdown and ketone levels during treatment. NCT07053306 is the identifier for this research study.

facts.sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio
